title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - BaseContainerImage
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/BaseContainerImage. A set of tags for an image and a repository link.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'BaseContainerImage'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

containerImageTag.description: Property. Tag(s) associated with a container image.

containerImageLink.description: Property. Link to the image's repository.
